text: ngekusebenta kwakhe utfutfukisa sive sakubo
nguko ke loku kwakadzeni lokwacosha emaswati nato tonkhe tive letimnyama kutsi bangayi kubodokotela
maswati kuhle ke njengoba sihamba nani siyobuka kuto tonkhe letindzawo
titselo letihlanyelwa balimi eswatini ngunati emahhabhula, emaphopho, phayinaphu, mangoza nalokunye
atsi kadze ayilindzile ase ayifaka ebhodweni alungisela kuyipheka
nika sicephu ngasinye lokumele sifundvwe bafundzi ukhombise nendlela yekusifundza
thousand
ngilinganisa kutsi libutfo uma lifika la, ngisho nome ukuphi uva ngelikhwela
yesuka imbila yalala bukululu eceleni kwendlela
kepha ngendiza kutsatsa li-awa linye nesigamu
timo tendzawo kulelive nato tingadlala indzima.
kusengakalungiswa tintfo sekuvakala kutsi sekukhona labafohla bodaladi lapha
ngetukwaloko kugiya kwembongi kwakubajabulisa bantfu lababukelako
njengoba nje ngangisho la kutsi labanye labacoshwa kuleto tikhatsi vele leyomali ibaphunyukile
ngatsi kahleni ngitawuniphendvula nonkhe nisho nje mane nesaba kukusho
kwatsi nga. watsatsa lamatsebula nalamotsa lokwaba tesulamsiti
themba kodvwa ke bantfu sebagibele
tonkhe tilwane betitsandza kakhulu kuyisebentela
uyabona kute uphumelele kumele ngikusite ungate ucambe emanga kakhulu, mine ngifike enhlangano ngaboleveni
bafana tinkhomo batichuba bacalata lamalanga
ngaloko ke anginidvumise kakhulu ngekuphumelela kwalemisebentu yenu kutsi cha, impela nilimisile lakangwane
ku-standardization kubuketwe letindzaba letilandzelako tikhangiso tibuya kuphi
lapha emhlabeni jikelele tilwane tonkhe setitsi nayi inkhosi yemavila inkhubabulongwe
ten
kufanele ugcizelele kulolongwa kwekutfutfukiswa kweminyakato lekukhulunywe ngayo esigabeni lesengcile
watsi umfundzisi lendzaba loyikhulumako yinkhulu sibili
ngalendlela singakwati kutsi idrama idlalwe ngesikhatsi sinye etindzaweni letehlukene esiteji
emajubantsendzele ngunati timotokali ungatsi timishini
bakubika engilandi loko, nalamuhla loku kusengilandi solomane siphilile sibhekile
pat bengitsi phela njengaloya mfanyana utawunamatsela emacinisweni, kunekutsi uhheme
seven
tabito tekubala letinetinhlobo letimbili letinesicu sodvwa nkhe, nalesinesicu bili, tsatfu, ne hlanu
ungesuka ligonso awusefiki laphayi nawungasefiki wemukele
tfumela emafomu ekufaka sicelo kulelihhovisi lekulawula.
